description: This file defines the DynamicField class which manages the creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and caching of custom dynamic fields in a SuiteCRM module. It handles database schema modifications, widget retrieval, cache building, label management, and related operations concerning custom fields and their metadata within the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: DynamicField
classes.description: A class responsible for managing custom dynamic fields in SuiteCRM, including cache building, schema alterations, label management, and CRUD operations for custom fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DynamicField object for a specific module, determining database connection and module path.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module associated with this dynamic field instance.

methods.name: getPackageName
methods.description: Placeholder for package name retrieval, currently returns nothing.

methods.name: deleteCache
methods.description: Static method placeholder to delete cache, currently does nothing.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Associates a SugarBean object with the dynamic field, building cache if necessary.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the module in a specific language by invoking the parser.

methods.name: buildCache
methods.description: Builds the cache of custom fields for a module by querying the database and preparing vardefs.

methods.name: getFieldWidget
methods.description: Retrieves the widget object corresponding to a custom field in a module.

methods.name: saveToVardef
methods.description: Updates the vardefs with custom field information and saves the cache.

methods.name: getJOIN
methods.description: Generates the SQL select and join snippets for retrieving custom fields in list queries.

methods.name: getRelateJoin
methods.description: Creates join clauses for relate-type custom fields.

methods.name: fill_relationships
methods.description: Fills in related module data for relate fields in the bean.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes and saves custom field data into the database and cache.

methods.name: deleteField
methods.description: Deletes a custom field and its associated database column, then refreshes vardefs.

methods.name: fieldExists
methods.description: Checks if a custom field already exists in the vardefs.

methods.name: addFieldObject
methods.description: Adds a custom field by creating the database column and updating vardefs.

methods.name: createCustomTable
methods.description: Creates the custom data table for a module if it does not already exist.

methods.name: add_existing_custom_fields
methods.description: Ensures all defined custom fields exist in the database schema.

methods.name: add_existing_custom_field
methods.description: Creates a database schema for a specific custom field.

methods.name: repairCustomFields
methods.description: Checks and repairs the custom fields schema in the database.

methods.name: addLabel
methods.description: Adds a language label to the module's language files.

methods.name: getDBName
methods.description: Returns a sanitized database-safe name for a field or label.

methods.name: setWhereClauses
methods.description: Adds where clauses for filtering based on custom fields.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Loads custom field data for a bean from the database.

methods.name: populateXTPL
methods.description: Populates an XTemplate with custom field data for a specific view.

methods.name: populateAllXTPL
methods.description: Wrapper to populate XTPL with all custom fields.

methods.name: getAllFieldsView
methods.description: Gets views data for all custom fields for a specific view type.
